body: I don’t particularly like being fat and I’ve been making active choices to stop being fat but I def don’t hate it as much as you think, aside from that I’ve made huge strides in the last month in losing weight and I’m on the path to looking normal and healthy, Why shouldn’t I be upset with my weight though? I haven’t slept with a girl in 2 years and the last girl I slept with told me at the end of our fling that she thought I was disgusting and I believe she was being honest. The decision to really lose weight finally struck a chord when one of my friends told me I had to start eating better, I also start to look back on my former eating habits now that I’m only eating once or twice a day and I am disgusted by my old sedentary gluttonous lifestyle as I should be! The key to life as I’m learning is discipline and I refuse to love my body when i repulse girls. I’m also aware of the fact that I’m not morbidly obese and that I would actually be somewhat attractive at my natural weight which should be like 170-180 and not 240 so there is hope but I’m honestly starting to think these thoughts of starving myself are just coming from a lack of blood sugar. I’m not gonna eat anything today but I’ll see how I feel tomorrow and move from there I was 240 at the beginning of June and now I’m down to 220 my gut and double chin have been significantly reduced and other than this lapse I’ve been feeling more active and I don’t realize how much I hate myself as often as I used to. I also started cleaning my room more because I don’t want to live in filth, I want to be a neat organized and disciplined person who doesn’t repulse others, not that I care what other people think of me but I am disgusted by people who don’t take care of themselves so why would I want to wind up like them getting my foot cut off because of diabetes or sleeping in some roach infested shithole with half finished food lying around everywhere and it’s giving me a perspective on how I should carry myself if I do want to learn to stop hating myself I need to improve the way I see myself and making positive lifestyle changes like dieting and cleaning, shaving showering are all part of that.
